explanation: Template specialization in C++ allows developers to define custom implementations of a template for specific types or conditions. It is used to optimize or modify behavior when the general template does not suffice, enabling more precise control over template instantiation and behavior for particular types. This feature is essential for writing flexible, type-safe, and efficient generic code in modern C++.
keywords: Template Specialization, Partial Specialization, Full Specialization, C++ specialization
